pipeline_name: Project HiveMind x AutoevolveAI Cross-Session Research Pipeline
lead_peer_review_model: none (scripted static audit; no language-model call)

evolutionary_loop_protocol.step_1_mutate: Select an open task from `HM-M1-01` .. `HM-M5-02` in `docs/CONTRIBUTOR_TASKS_AND_BOUNTIES.md`.
evolutionary_loop_protocol.step_2_formal_gate: Extend `lean4/HiveMindSpec.lean` with the new invariant and verify `cd lean4 && lake build` exits 0 with 0 `sorry` and 0 `axiom`.
evolutionary_loop_protocol.step_3_empirical_gate: Run `PYTHONPATH=src pytest tests/ -v` and verify 8 GB RTX 2070 VRAM ceiling (<= 6,500 MiB) and deterministic spot-check drift (<= 1e-4).
evolutionary_loop_protocol.step_4_peer_review_and_pdf: Run `PYTHONPATH=src python paper/autoevolve_peer_review_pipeline.py` and `pdflatex paper/hivemind_foundation_article.tex` to run the 5 scripted audit rounds (no language model is called).
